hooks.name: Verify core boundaries and accessibility before finishing
hooks.description: When the agent ends its turn: keeps it working if any src/core file imports src/apps or src/shell (the core must stay app-agnostic, tests included), and, if React components or CSS changed, asks it once to confirm the axe-core WCAG 2.2 AA audit, Elder Care AAA contrast, keyboard access and 4 px focus rings.
